verdict.rationale: Conductor runs agents from multiple providers (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode). It offers a model 'loadout' with keyboard shortcuts to switch models, effort and speed within a session, and lets you bring your own subscriptions or API keys per agent. Early community requests for non-Claude agents predate these docs and do not contradict them. Missing for 10: no documented list of the specific models or providers available in the picker, and no independent hands-on confirmation of per-session model switching.
